question: Who was the founder of Arya Samaj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dayanand Saraswati**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dayanand Saraswati** was the founder of the Arya Samaj, a Hindu reform movement, in 1875.
 
• The Arya Samaj was established to promote values and practices based on the infallibility of the Vedas.
 
• Dayanand Saraswati advocated for monotheism, the rejection of idol worship, and the pursuit of Vedic knowledge.</li&g
